note: The CUA models under test. A run names one by its short key; the key resolves
to Azure when that model has a deployment there (free for this project) and to
azure: the deployment name on the collaborator's Azure endpoint, or null when
it is not deployed. Fill one in as soon as the deployment exists -- nothing
else has to change. `python odyssey/models.py --probe` asks the endpoint which
of these ids answer and prints the keys whose azure field is now wrong.
price: USD per million tokens, used to price a run when the provider does not
return a cost. OpenRouter reports its own cost per call and that number wins;
these are the fallback and the estimate before a run.
Gemini 4 Pro is in this file as `gemini-pro` pointing at Gemini 3.1 Pro:
Google has not released a Gemini 4 model, id or price (training confirmed on
the July 2026 earnings call, nothing shipped). Repoint it when it exists.

cache_read_multiplier: measured 2026-09-26, second-call cost over first-call cost for a repeated prefix. 1.0 means the provider reported no cached tokens. null means it could not be measured; see cache_note.
